//: bfdb --instances <this file>. One entry per DCS server on this machine. Without --instances, legacy CLI flags synthesize one instance id "default".
//default: Which instance answers a request with no ?instance=. Defaults to the first entry.

instances.//: Stable URL-safe key. Rounds in the Sled DB are tagged with it -- never change it once a campaign has run.
instances.label: Attrition #1
instances.//base: netidx_base from THIS instance's engine CFG. Two instances must never share one.
instances.//sortie: Leave null. Hint only until the engine reports in.
instances.//export_port: UDP port this instance's Scripts/Export.lua sends to. Unique per instance.
instances.//srs_url: Ciribob SRS HTTP API base (bfdb GETs {url}/clients).
instances.//server_ip: Public DCS connect address shown in the dashboard top bar.

instances.label: Attrition #2 (staging)
instances.//public: false = test/staging: hidden from public GET /api/instances for non-admins.
